811292.title: Gallium, germanium, indium etc. (unwrought basket)

811010.title: Antimony, unwrought; powders

810194.title: Tungsten, unwrought; powders

850511.title: Permanent magnets, metal (incl. rare-earth NdFeB)

810320.title: Tantalum, unwrought; powders
